host.description: IP address or hostname the server binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for client connections.

ssl_certificate.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key.description: Absolute path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

password_file.description: Path to INI-style file containing user credentials (format: [users] username=password).

ca_certificate.description: Path to CA certificate file (PEM) used to verify client certificates. Required if cert_auth=true.

require_cert.description: Require every connecting client to present a valid certificate (only effective if cert_auth=true).

allowed_cert_fingerprints.description: List of allowed client certificate fingerprints (SHA-256, hex). When non-empty, only certs in this list are accepted regardless of CA.

items.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of an allowed certificate, in uppercase hex (e.g., 'AB:CD:12...')

file.description: Path to log file. Empty string means log to standard output.

rotate_max_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) per log file before rotation (if rotate=true).

rotate_max_files.description: Number of old log files to retain after rotation.

autosave_dir.description: Directory path to store autosaved documents (empty disables autosave).

versioning_dir.description: Directory for storing version history (only used if versioning=true).
